description: Angular component for a knob widget with interactive rotation, value display, and graphical gauge integration, used within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: KnobComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing an interactive knob widget with graphical gauge, value display, and user interaction handling.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes component, sets up DOM references, resize observer, and calls init method.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resize observer and completes control API command.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Configures widget settings, initializes gauge, sets up event handlers for interaction, and prepares graphical elements.

methods.name: degreeToRatio
methods.description: Converts a degree value to a ratio between 0 and 1 based on min/max degrees.

methods.name: ratioToDegree
methods.description: Converts a ratio (0-1) to a degree value within min/max degrees.

methods.name: turn
methods.description: Updates the knob's visual rotation and value based on a ratio.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Adjusts size of the knob and gauge elements on container resize.

methods.name: checkValueSize
methods.description: Adjusts font size of the value display to fit container.

methods.name: setFontSize
methods.description: Sets font size for an element to fit within max width.

methods.name: measureTextWidth
methods.description: Measures the width of a text string at a given font size.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the visual and internal value of the knob based on a numeric input.

methods.name: updateColor
methods.description: Updates the color styling of the knob based on a given color.

methods.name: onValue
methods.description: Handles updates when the value changes.

methods.name: formatValue
methods.description: Formats a numeric value into a string based on the configured formatter.

methods.name: rpcUpdateValue
methods.description: Sends the updated value via RPC, with handling for ongoing updates and error states.
